decision: Each status update replaces the previous status and help text completely, and only the newest refresh's reply may update the strip, without losing the working Retry control.

evidence.note: Haiku 5.5 failed 2/2 with skill content (repeated-request ownership defective; one answer's metadata path applied nothing even for the current reply); another model failed 2/2.

variants.why: Uses an identity token per request and writes all accessible status from one place, folding the reason into the label.
Clears the stale hint but lets any reply, including an older one, overwrite the strip.
Guards replies but leaves the old failure in Retry's hint after recovery.
Over-guards: captures the counter before bumping it, so even the current reply is ignored.
Resets Retry by removing its targets, so the ordinary Retry action stops working.
